mapper.insert: INSERT INTO house (landlord_id, title, description, address, province, city, district, latitude, longitude, price, deposit, area, room_count, hall_count, bathroom_count, floor, total_floor, orientation, rent_type, available_date, utilities, requirements, status, view_count, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{landlordId}, #{title}, #{description}, #{address}, #{province}, #{city}, #{district}, #{latitude}, #{longitude}, #{price}, #{deposit}, #{area}, #{roomCount}, #{hallCount}, #{bathroomCount}, #{floor}, #{totalFloor}, #{orientation}, #{rentType}, #{availableDate}, #{utilities}, #{requirements}, 1, 0, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE house SET status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM house WHERE landlord_id = #{landlordId} ORDER BY create_time DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE house SET view_count = view_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT h.id, h.title, h.price, h.latitude, h.longitude, hi.url AS coverImage FROM house h LEFT JOIN house_image hi ON h.id = hi.house_id AND hi.is_cover = 1 WHERE h.status = 1 AND h.latitude BETWEEN #{minLat} AND #{maxLat} AND h.longitude BETWEEN #{minLng} AND #{maxLng}

SELECT h.id, h.title, h.price, h.latitude, h.longitude, hi.url AS coverImage FROM house h LEFT JOIN house_image hi ON h.id = hi.house_id AND hi.is_cover = 1 WHERE h.landlord_id = #{landlordId} ORDER BY h.create_time DESC
